data.one_liner: Firebase UI widgets for Sign in with Apple authentication.
data.what_it_does: Provides Firebase UI widgets and integration specifically for authenticating users via Apple OAuth within a Firebase application. Handles signing in and linking Apple credentials to existing accounts.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app using Firebase backend and need Sign in with Apple.
You want pre-built UI components for Apple authentication via Firebase Auth.
avoid_when: You are not using Firebase for your backend authentication.
You prefer implementing a completely custom Apple sign-in UI flow from scratch.
strengths: Seamless integration with Firebase Auth and FlutterFire ecosystem.
Pre-built UI widgets for Apple OAuth.
Supports linking Apple credentials to anonymous or existing users.
weaknesses: Tied tightly to Firebase and the Firebase UI ecosystem.
Requires platform-specific configuration for Apple Sign In.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up Sign in with Apple capabilities in your Apple Developer account and configuring Firebase Auth providers.

alternatives.name: sign_in_with_apple
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need low-level control over the Apple Sign In flow without relying on the Firebase UI widget set.

data.minimal_example: To get started with Firebase UI OAuth Apple, please see the documentation: https://github.com/firebase/FirebaseUI-Flutter/blob/main/docs/firebase-ui-auth/providers/oauth.md#sign-in-with-apple
